title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch Solid Brass | Matte White | Freestanding | Carolina | Allied Brass
short_title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch, Matte White
description:
Keep paper towels within easy reach without using wall space—this freestanding paper towel holder keeps the roll upright and stable on your kitchen counter in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy kitchens atmosphere.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Save counter space with an upright, freestanding design that requires no mounting
- Protect countertops from scuffs with a felt pad on the base
- Coordinate your kitchen with the Carolina Collection for a matching Carolina look across your hardware
- Built for everyday use from solid brass with a durable designer finish

Specs & Installation:
- Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic styling)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding; no assembly required
- Overall size: 6.5 in L x 6.5 in W x 14.4 in H (projection 6.5 in)
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Included: Paper towel holder
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
